problem: A solo AI services studio must discover leads, quote, execute and deliver. Who owns each action when the UI closes, a worker crashes, terms change or a receipt is lost?
principle: Use the order as the business spine. Agents interpret and propose; scoped workers act. Server-owned transitions, trusted approvals and verified funds control progress.
scope: This teaching design derives from inspected ForgePilot workflows and runtime boundaries. Pure Python contracts are rewritten here; project mechanisms, local tests and unverified production integrations are distinguished.
diagram_title: Personal studio: Agent proposals and server-controlled business actions
solutions: State machines own gates; models handle interpretation
Clear discovery, quotation and delivery ownership
Add roles only for concrete task needs
Link order versions, runs, artifacts and approvals
Long jobs, channel messages and human waits
Checkpoints do not ensure remote exactly-once
Separate credentials from execution; reconcile receipts
Contacting, accepting and delivering on platforms

steps: Discover and deduplicate native order IDs
Freeze scope and quote with the lead agent
Verify confirmation and deposit before start
procedures.state: Order/quote revisions, customer confirmation, verified funds, commercial and run approvals.
procedures.failure: Changed terms reopen quotation; a payment claim waits for verification.
procedures.measure: Zero starts without quote/funds gates; quotes trace back to scoped requirements.
procedures.case: A 1000 CNY job requires a 300 CNY deposit: a chat claim is insufficient; verify a matching 30000-minor-unit receipt.

steps: Freeze workflow and bounded work units
Approve exact delivery after full settlement
procedures.state: Flow snapshot, task/run, scopes, artifact hashes, original references and review/delivery approvals.
procedures.failure: Changed output invalidates delivery approval; rejected work returns to its owner.
procedures.measure: Delivered hash equals reviewed hash; reject cross-order access and credential exposure.
procedures.case: Report v3 was approved; v4 changes an attachment and needs renewed review despite the same order ID.

steps: Atomically persist action and unique operation
Send exact payload and save native receipt
procedures.state: Owner token, operation ID, payload hash, attempt, native receipt and unknown/confirmed state.
procedures.failure: Fence obsolete owners; unqueryable platform writes require human reconciliation.
procedures.measure: Repeated events create no new operation; uncertainty remains visible and traceable.
procedures.case: Delivery reached the platform but its response was lost: reconcile the original action instead of resending under a new key.

check: Does automatic run approval allow repricing, trusting payment claims and delivering any later artifact version?
answer: No. Run authority, commercial terms, verified funds and exact artifact delivery have separate gates. Scope, quote and artifact changes require corresponding revalidation.
